'''Barev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] serving the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] and served under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] and was placed in charge of the effort to capture the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He employed a [[Drivok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to locate them on a world map. The Drivok managed to locate the Jedi in the village of [[Torbel]]. He was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Durd for failing to capture the two.
